newsitem.title: USA: Municipal sales total $1.98 bln for Wednesday.
newsitem.headline: Municipal sales total $1.98 bln for Wednesday.

text.p: Scheduled competitive and negotiated municipal bond sales are expected to total $1.98 billion in 46 offerings for Wednesday, according to Reuters Municipal Bond Information Group.
Competitive sales total $588 million in 25 issues. The largest issue is a $320 million Los Angeles Harbor deal at 1200 EST.
Negotiated sales total $1.29 billion in 21 offerings. The largest is a $281 million New York State Dormitory Authority issue through Goldman Sachs & Co.

An additional $113 million of negotiated deals are on the possible calendar, meaning underwriters have said they may price them Wednesday depending on market conditions. --U.S. Municipal Information Group, 212-859-1826
